definitions.gloss: a fine piece, a superior-quality item, a particularly excellent example (of an artwork, antique, or commodity)
definitions.explanation: A written, somewhat formal word used mainly for artworks, antiques, tea utensils, and collectable goods to single out a piece of especially high quality among others in its category. Often encountered in auction catalogues, gallery descriptions, and dealer listings.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{優品|ゆうひん}だ。
⟦{展示品|てんじひん}→展示品：19234_tenjihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{特|とく}に→特に：01260_tokuni⟧{優品|ゆうひん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}える→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Among the items on display, this one can be called a particularly fine piece.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{茶碗|ちゃわん}→茶碗：01019_chawan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{優品|ゆうひん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: This tea bowl is known as a fine example from the Edo period.

notes:
A written, formal word of appraisal. Not used to praise everyday objects or food; reserved for art, craft, and collectable items where connoisseurship is in play.

USAGE:
- Most at home in auction-house catalogues, museum labels, antique shop listings, and tea-ceremony contexts.
- Frequently paired with a period, region, or maker to specify what category the piece is outstanding within.
- In conversation, speakers are more likely to say ⟦{上等|じょうとう}→上等：03821_joutou⟧⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ or simply ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧; {優品|ゆうひん} sounds bookish in spoken use.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{優品|ゆうひん}: a fine piece from (a given) period
- {優品|ゆうひん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{名高|なだか}い→名高い：11956_nadakai⟧: to be renowned as a fine piece
- {優品|ゆうひん}{揃|ぞろ}い: a lineup of fine pieces, a selection of superior items
- ⟦{名品|めいひん}→名品：19478_meihin⟧・{優品|ゆうひん}: (a pairing) famous works and fine pieces

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{名品|めいひん}→名品：19478_meihin⟧: famous work, masterpiece — emphasizes fame/recognition more than quality alone.
- ⟦{逸品|いっぴん}→逸品：19463_ippin⟧: choice item, gem — stronger praise, a stand-out piece in its class.
- ⟦{上品|じょうひん}→上品：03081_jouhin⟧: (as a noun) high-grade goods — overlaps with {優品|ゆうひん} but less common in modern usage; far more common as an adjective meaning 'refined, elegant'.
- ⟦{佳品|かひん}→佳品：24536_kahin⟧: a fine piece (slightly more literary than {優品|ゆうひん}).

REGISTER:
Formal, written. Read frequently in dealer and auction-catalogue language; rarely used in casual speech.
